cli.pyproject:
[project]
name = "medradar"
version = "0.5.0"
description = "FDA device & drug industry radar: big-pharma pipeline direction, China-gap comparison, and paper-trading event study."
readme = "README.md"
requires-python = ">=3.10"
license = { text = "MIT" }
authors = [{ name = "MedRadar contributors" }]
keywords = ["fda", "openfda", "medical-device", "clinical-trials", "quant", "china-gap",
            "sec-edgar", "research", "deepseek", "deepseek-harness"]
dependencies = []

[project.optional-dependencies]
excel = ["openpyxl>=3.1"]
pdf = ["pypdf>=4.0"]
dev = ["pytest>=8.0"]
bulk = ["ijson>=3.3"]

[project.urls]
Homepage = "https://chazy11.github.io/medradar/"
Repository = "https://github.com/ChazY11/medradar"
Attribution = "https://github.com/ChazY11/medradar/blob/main/docs/ATTRIBUTION.md"

[project.scripts]
medradar = "medradar.__main__:main"

[build-system]
requires = ["setuptools>=68"]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[tool.setuptools.packages.find]
include = ["medradar*"]

# JSON config is knowledge, not code: install it next to the wheel so a pip
# install is usable without the git checkout. `medradar.config` resolves this
# `share/medradar/config` location; the demo snapshot rides along so
# `medradar demo` also works from an installed copy (fully offline).
[tool.setuptools.data-files]
"share/medradar/config" = ["config/*.json", "config/*.csv"]
"share/medradar/docs" = ["docs/metrics.json"]

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
testpaths = ["tests"]
addopts = "-q"
